apps.description:

After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

Without entering complex commands, get past the opposing defense with a brilliant dribble or pass, then score a goal with a powerful shot.

[Ways of Playing]
Friend Matches and Co-op Matches with up to three a side are also in store. So get together with some friends and have a blast.

■ Player Development
Develop players through matches and special items, and strengthen their abilities.
Improve players the way you like, or use the "Auto Select" setting to develop them automatically.

[For More Fun]

Download weekly data that reflects player transfers and match achievements from real life.
Build up your team and play thrilling matches based on the latest happenings in the world of soccer.

■ Customize a Stadium
Get Stadium Elements, such as Tifos and Giant Props, and customize your own stadium.
Add color to the game by arranging your stadium however you like!

Belgium, Brazil (users under 18 years of age)

Germany (users under 12 years of age), Denmark (users under 15 years of age), United States of America (users under 16 years of age)

[For the Latest News]
New features, modes, events, and gameplay improvements will be continuously implemented.
For more information, see the official eFootball™ website.

[Downloading the Game]
Approximately 3.1 GB of free storage space is required to download and install eFootball™.
Please make sure you have enough free space before beginning the download.
We also recommend that you use a Wi-Fi connection to download the base game and any of its updates.

[Online Connectivity]
An internet connection is required to play eFootball™. We also strongly recommend playing with a stable connection to ensure you get the most out of the game.

apps.title: Hill Climb Racing
apps.description:
Hill Climb Racing is free to download and play and includes optional in-app purchases, including random-item purchases. You can disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
_______________________

Play the original classic Hill Climb Racing! Race your way uphill in this physics based driving game, playable offline!

Meet Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey through Climb Canyon that takes him to where no ride has ever been before. With little respect to the laws of physics, Bill will not rest until he has conquered the highest hills up on the moon!

Face challenges in unique hill climbing environments with a wide variety of cars to choose from. Earn points from daring tricks and collect coins to upgrade your car and travel further distances. Watch out though - Bill's neck is not what it used to be when he was a kid! And his good old gasoline crematorium will easily run out of fuel.

Features::

Fresh Content
We are still actively developing Hill Climb Racing and adding new vehicles, new stages and new content! 

Unique Vehicles
Get behind the wheel of a wide variety of different vehicles. From the iconic Hill Climber to bikes, race cars, trucks and even some outlandish vehicles such as the creepy Carantula! Half car, half tarantula, do you dare drive it?

Play Offline
Race offline whenever and wherever you want! Hill Climb Racing is playable completely offline. Play it on a bus, plane or train! Play it anywhere!

Wacky Stages
Climb Canyon is full of unique challenges and stages for you to overcome with vastly different terrains and hazards. How far can you drive without running out of gas or crashing your vehicle?

Unlock and Upgrade
Tune up and fix your dream vehicle with custom parts, skins and upgrades!

Simulated Physics
We worked hard on creating a one of a kind in-game physics system where your vehicles will react to the terrain in a unique manner, can you use this to your advantage and conquer the hills? 

Daily challenges and events
Tackle the daily challenges and events to earn epic rewards!

apps.title: Rider – Stunt Bike Racing

Gear up for the ultimate challenge in Rider, where the laws of physics are redefined and the stakes are higher than ever. 

Brace yourself for a rollercoaster ride through the realm of pure arcade gaming, where every twist and turn defies expectations. 
Drive your trusty motorcycle through a gauntlet of intense races, where mastering the art of flips, executing daring stunts, and executing lightning-fast dashes is paramount. But beware, as you'll need to jump over treacherous obstacles and defy gravity in a world of relentless danger and heart-pounding thrills.
 
In Rider, the challenge isn't just about speed, it's about mastering the unique physics that govern this adrenaline-fueled world.
Prepare to confront impossible tracks and overcome daunting obstacles, where every move requires precision and finesse. Only those with the utmost skill and determination will ascend to the ranks of champions, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. 

Test your rhythm, refine your timing, and showcase your dexterity as you strive to shatter records and achieve the highest scores.
 
🏍️Master the game and complete up to 100 challenges! 
🏍️ Collect 40 extraordinary bikes and 4 secret vehicles!
🏍️ Get daily rewards to progress faster and unlock exclusive perks 
🏍️ Complete 32 increasingly levels and become a Rider master
🏍️ Unlock 10 different themes for a unique arcade experience
🏍️ Make insane stunts!
🏍️ Compare your highscore with players worldwide: will you rise to the top?
 
Dive into the pulse-pounding action of Rider and experience the thrill of conquering a game that challenges both your reflexes and your understanding of physics. With its minimalist graphics and neon-lit landscapes, Rider offers a visually striking journey into the world of arcade gaming. 

Are you ready to defy gravity and emerge as the ultimate champion in Rider?

apps.title: Bead 12 - 12 Guti Board Game
apps.description: Bead 12 is a traditional two-player strategy board game played with 12 pieces on each side. It is especially popular across South Asia, including India and Bangladesh, where it is commonly known as 12 Guti, Baro Guti or Bara Tehni. f you enjoy Chess, Checkers or other strategy board games, give Bead 12 a try. The rules are easy to understand, but choosing the right move and blocking your opponent’s plans requires careful strategy. This balance makes the traditional game enjoyable for both new and experienced players. The game is also known by regional names such as 12 Tehni, 12 Tani and 12 Kaati. In some places, it is called 24 Guti because both players use 12 beads each. Play Bead 12 online against other players, challenge the computer, or enjoy a local two-player game with friends and family on the same device. HOW TO PLAY BEAD 12 The 12 Guti game is played on a 5×5 board. Each player controls 12 beads, also called Guti, Goti, pawns or soldiers, with one empty position available at the beginning. Players take turns moving one bead at a time along the lines of the board to an adjacent empty position. To capture an opponent’s bead, jump over an adjacent opponent bead into the empty position directly behind it. The jump must follow a valid straight line on the board. The captured bead is then removed. Players continue moving and capturing until one player captures all the opponent’s beads and wins the match. CHOOSE HOW YOU WANT TO PLAY Play Online Challenge other players online, improve your strategy and compete for a higher position in the weekly league. Play Against Computer Play 12 Goti Game against the computer with three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard. Local Two-Player Game Play Bara Tehni with a friend or family member on the same device. COMPETE IN THE WEEKLY LEAGUE Play online matches, earn points and climb the weekly league rankings. Compete against other players and aim for a top position before the league ends. UNLOCK BADGES Complete challenges, achieve milestones and collect badges that showcase your progress and accomplishments in Bead 12. PERSONALIZE YOUR GAME Choose from multiple board and bead themes to give your 12 Guti matches a fresh look. Switch themes anytime and play with the style you like most. BEAD 12 GAME FEATURES * Classic 12 Guti and Baro Guti gameplay * Online matches against other players * Single-player mode against the computer * Easy, Medium and Hard computer difficulties * Local two-player mode on one device * Weekly league and competitive rankings * Unlockable badges and achievements * Multiple board and bead themes * Emoji chat and text chat during online matches * Weekly, monthly and all-time game statistics * Simple controls and traditional 5×5 board gameplay * Quick strategy matches with friends and family Whether you call it Bead 12, 12 Guti, 12 Goti Game, Baro Guti, Bara Tehni, 12 Tani Game or 24 Guti, enjoy this classic board game and sharpen your strategy with every match. We are constantly working to improve Bead 12. Share your feedback with us at regleware@gmail.com

apps.title: Sholo Guti (16 beads)
apps.description:
Sholo Guti (16 Beads) game is famous in south-east asia mainly in Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Saudi Arab, Indonesia, Nepal. This Indian Board game also known as bagh-bakri,tiger-goat,tiger trap or baghchal,draughts, 16 gitti, Sixteen Soldiers,Bara Tehn or barah goti game.
This game is very familiar in almost all the parts of our country. It's specifically a very popular game in rural areas. This game has so much popularity in some areas that sometimes people arrange tournament of this game. Sholo Guti is a game of extreme patient and intelligence. One has to be very tactful and has to move a bead very carefully while playing. 

How To Play ::- 

This game begins between two players and there is 32 guti altogether of which everyone possesses 16 beads. Two players place their sixteen beads from the edge of the board. As a result the middle line remains empty so that the players can make their move in the free spaces. It's decided before who will make the first move to play. 
After the beginning of the game, the players can move their beads one step forward, backward, right, and left and diagonally where there is an empty space. Each player tries to seize opponent’s beads. If a player can cross a pawn of the other player, than that bead will be deducted. Thus that player will be winner who can capture all the beads of his opponent first.

apps.title: 3 & 16 Beads
apps.description:
A small Collection of two Strategy Based Board Games. This two games are very popular in the rural part of Bangladesh.

3 Beads (৩ গুটি) : This game is played between two players and almost similar to Tictactoe. Instead of having blank at the initial move, each player have three pieces. A player can drag one of his beads and can put it on a valid position. The player who can place his/her all three beads horizontally/vertically or diagonally (except the initial positions) wins the game.

16 Beads (১৬ গুটি): This game is also played between two players and similar to Checkers. Each player have 16 beads initially. A player can move one of his/her bead in a valid position just one step connected, but he/she can destroy opponent bead by crossing it and placing in a valid position. If a player can destroy another opponents bead just after destroying a bead, he/she can continue his/her move. The player who destroy all 16 beads of his/her opponents, he/she will win.

Game Features:
1. Single Player, Offline Multiplayer
2. Different difficulty level for single player

Welcome to Sholo Guti: Bead 16 Board Game!

Experience the ultimate traditional strategy board game right on your mobile device. Played for centuries across India, Bangladesh, and Southeast Asia, this classic abstract strategy game is known by many names: 16 Goti, Indian Checkers, Sixteen Soldiers, and Sholo Guti.

Whether you want to challenge your brain against a smart AI or enjoy a fun multiplayer match with friends, our game offers the perfect mix of traditional rural gameplay and modern features!

✨ Top Game Features:
• 🌍 Online Multiplayer: Play real-time matches with friends and global players. Show off your 16 Goti strategy skills to the world!

How to Play:
The rules are simple, similar to Checkers or Alquerque. Each player starts with 16 beads. Players take turns moving one piece to an adjacent empty spot along the board's lines. The first player to capture all 16 enemy beads wins the match.

Perfect for fans of classic board games, draft games, and regional favorites like Baghchal, Bara Tehni, and Checkers.

Dive into the ultimate classic strategy game, Sholo Guti: Bead 16, also known as 16 Bead, 16 Guti, or Bead 16. Popular across South-East Asia, Sholo Guti – Bead 16 is often compared to Chess and Checkers for its deep strategic gameplay.

apps.title: Sholo Guti (Bead 16) Offline
apps.description:
Sholo Guti, also known as Sixteen Soldiers, is a traditional two-player board game that enjoys popularity in various South Asian countries, including Bangladesh, India, and Sri Lanka. While it may not be as well-known globally as chess or checkers, it holds a cherished place in the hearts of those who have experienced its strategic gameplay.

**Popularity and Regional Names:**
Sholo Guti is known by different names in various regions where it is played. These names include:

1. **Bangladesh:** Sholo Guti
2. **India:** Solah Ata (Sixteen Soldiers)
3. **Sri Lanka:** Damii Ata (Sixteen Soldiers)

**Game Setup:**
- Sholo Guti is played on a square board with 17x17 intersecting points, resulting in 16 rows and 16 columns, totaling 256 points.
- Each player starts with 16 pieces arranged on opposite sides of the board.
- The pieces are typically represented by small, circular tokens, with one player using dark tokens and the other using light ones.

**Objective:**
The primary goal of Sholo Guti is to eliminate your opponent's pieces while protecting your own. The player who captures all of the opponent's pieces or immobilizes them so they cannot make any legal moves wins the game.

**Gameplay Rules:**
1. Players take turns to make their moves.
2. A piece can move to an adjacent empty point along the intersecting lines (diagonally or horizontally/vertically).
3. To capture an opponent's piece, a player must jump over it in a straight line to an empty point immediately beyond. The captured piece is then removed from the board.
4. Multiple captures can be made in a single turn as long as the jumps are in a straight line and follow the rules.
5. Capturing is mandatory if a player has a capturing opportunity; failure to do so results in a penalty.
6. The game ends when one player captures all of the opponent's pieces or immobilizes them.

**Strategy and Tactics:**
Sholo Guti is a game of strategy, requiring players to think several moves ahead. Some key strategies include:
- Setting up traps to force your opponent into making capturing moves.
- Protecting key pieces by positioning them strategically.
- Calculating the trade-offs between capturing and preserving your own pieces.

**Cultural Significance:**
Sholo Guti is not just a game; it's a cultural tradition in South Asia. It brings families and friends together, especially during holidays and gatherings, providing a platform for social interaction and friendly competition. The game's historical and cultural significance is deeply rooted in the region's heritage.

In conclusion, Sholo Guti is a traditional board game popular in South Asian countries like Bangladesh, India, and Sri Lanka. Known by various names, it involves strategic gameplay where players aim to capture their opponent's pieces while safeguarding their own. This classic game represents an important cultural tradition, fostering social bonds and offering an engaging pastime for generations of players.

Milkolect - Milk Collection & Dairy Management

Milkolect is complete milk collection and dairy management for Android phones and tablets. For dairy plants, sub-plants, BMC, VLC and farmers.

Bluetooth collection, accounts, reports and Users & Roles. Parent-child hierarchy from plant to farmer.

Core Features

• Milk collection: manual and Bluetooth entry for Fat, SNF, CLR, qty and amount. Cow and buffalo, morning and evening sessions.

• Collection modes: Centre Collection Mode, Dock Collection Mode.

• Offline-first: collect without internet. Local storage with auto sync when online.

• FTP and Bond: automatic collection via Bond configuration and FTP transfer.

• External display: live analyzer and scale readings at the counter.

• Milk dispatch: dispatch note, goods receipt and invoice. Bill as per dispatch or receipt liters. Difference report for gaps.

• Bluetooth hardware: up to 5 devices. Analyzers, weighing scales, thermal printers, external displays.

• Thermal printing: collection slips and bills on Bluetooth printers.

• Reports and ledger: collection reports, deposition and rejection summary, farmer and supplier ledger, payment register, subsidy reports, advance billing.

• Exports: PDF, Excel and CSV from the app.

• Accounting: additions, deductions, instalments, cattle feed, advances, settlements, sale and purchase returns, milk sale receipts, supplier payments, stock transfer, custom items and suppliers.

• Bank loans: create loans, disburse instalments, deduct on bills, edit amounts, track in transactions. Loan name on bill, PDF and Excel.

• Bill adjustments: correct latest bill depositor-wise. Change heads, add deduction and addition, add loan installment within net pay.

• Custom bill heads: per-litre or flat addition and deduction heads.

• TDS: threshold and rate with auto deduction on bills above your limit.

• Slab charges: tiered flat-fee deductions by bill amount slabs.

• Rate charts: normal or step-based Fat / SNF / CLR. Manual or Excel upload.

• Rate adjustments: cow and buffalo differences per group or session. Step-based offsets by quantity.

• Groups: depositor groups with cow and buffalo rate differences on any base chart.

• Parent-child hierarchy: Plant, Sub Plant, BMC, VLC and Farmers. KYC and bank details. Parent-child rate charts and collection settings. Manual add or Excel upload. Child milk collection from parent center.

• Depositors directory: sequence, status, KYC and bank details.

• Multi-center: manage multiple centres across the hierarchy on mobile.

• SMS and security: SMS after collection or transactions, device tracking, remote logout, secure sessions.

• Languages: English, Hindi and Marathi in app, PDF, Excel and thermal prints.

Users & Roles

Control who runs your dairy plant without sharing one owner login.

• Roles: Operator, Supervisor, Accountant and Manager packs
• Center users: staff logins under your center, tied to one role
• Permissions: create, view, edit, delete for Collection, Dispatch, Customers, Reports, Bills, Routes, Vehicles and Settings
• Route assignment: staff see only that route's depositors and children. Owner can collect any route
• Vehicle assignment: tie staff to a tanker for accountability
• Accessible centers: all centers by default, or select specific centers and their children
• Live updates: apply within seconds. Disable user or unassign route to force logout

Users & Roles gates modules. It does not replace Collection, Dispatch, Reports or Bills.

Farmer Login

Farmers use the same Milkolect Android app with their own login.

• Dashboard with CM/BM session summary and rates
• Milk depositions with date and session filters (fat, SNF, CLR, qty, amount)
• Bill reports with deductions, additions, net pay and PDF download
• Transaction history and outstanding balances (advance, cattle feed)

Built for collection, billing, hardware and staff access from plant to farmer.

apps.title: MilkBook: Dairy Management
apps.description:
Replace your paper milk diary and bahi khata. MilkBook is a milk delivery app that keeps every customer’s milk account: daily doodh entries, cow milk and buffalo milk on the same house, monthly milk bills, and udhaar that does not vanish when the month ends.

Run the round even when the network drops. Entries live on your phone and sync when you are back online. Use Gujarati, Hindi, English, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, or Kannada.

You can turn on scheduled auto-record so MilkBook logs each customer’s standing daily quantity at your morning and evening times — 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM by default. You only correct the houses that skipped or took extra.

Or log the whole round in seconds on bulk entry: every customer, subah and shaam, one pass. Cow milk and buffalo milk show as their own lines, each with its own quantity and rate, and they land on one milk bill.

Why vendors use MilkBook

• Works offline on the milk round
• Full Gujarati, Hindi, and English — plus Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada
• Cow milk and buffalo milk as named types, not a generic product row
• Optional scheduled auto-record from each customer’s standing quantity
• Bulk daily entry as its own screen
• Standard plan for up to 10 customers; optional Premium adds auto-record and delivery-staff tools

The khata, not a spreadsheet

• Per-customer rates, morning / evening / both, and a standing daily quantity
• Stop a customer without losing their history
• Monthly milk bills, or 10-day and half-month cycles per customer
• Balance carry-forward between bills
• One payment can be split across several outstanding bills
• Record collections from your customers in cash, UPI, bank, or cheque
• Bill PDF you can share on WhatsApp (or as an image). Add your logo and a UPI QR so your customers can pay their milk bill
• Daily and monthly reports, plus CSV / Excel export
• Delivery history with back-dated corrections
• Counter sales and other dairy items (curd, ghee, and more) on the same customer
• Optional delivery-staff tools so helpers can mark today’s round and collect payments

Who it is for

• Doodh walas and milkmen on a home-delivery round
• Dairy farmers and small dairy shops keeping a milk account
• Milk delivery agencies that need staff on the route
• Anyone still doing doodh hisab in a paper register

MilkBook is a dairy management app and milk delivery ledger — doodh hisab, customer khata, and milk billing in your pocket. It is not a collection-center app.

Getting started

Open MilkBook, add your customers, and record cow and buffalo. Generate the monthly milk bill and keep udhar khata without the night-time register.

apps.title: Offroad Hill Racing
apps.description:
Offroad Hill Racing is a skill-based offroad and hill-climb racer built around realistic hill physics, meaningful car upgrades, and tricky terrain. Learn each slope, read the surface, balance throttle and brakes, and tune your vehicle to conquer steep climbs, rocky descents, mud, sand, snow, and gravel. Simple controls, deep mastery, fair progression — no pay-to-win.

Why you’ll love it
• Real hill physics & readable handling — momentum, weight transfer, traction and suspension actually matter.
• Meaningful upgrades — engine, torque, gears, suspension, damping, tires, grip, weight balance, aerodynamics, fuel tank, brakes, differential, plus cosmetic skins.
• Hand-crafted offroad tracks — steep hills, uneven surfaces, loose soil, soft sand, icy patches, mud pits, rock gardens, whoops, jumps, off-camber turns.
• Fair progression — earn coins and parts by driving well; skill and smart tuning beat brute force.
• Quick restarts & tight feedback loop — short sessions, instant learning, satisfying retries.
• Events & goals — time trials, distance runs, fuel-save and traction challenges with seasonal rewards.
• Offline friendly — play anywhere. Headphones recommended for engine notes and surface feedback.

Drive • Learn • Tune • Conquer
1) Drive: feel weight transfer on climbs and descents; keep traction on dirt, snow, and rocks.
2) Learn: memorize bumps, ruts, crests, braking zones; master throttle, brake, and tilt.
3) Tune: fix what holds you back — gearing for climbs, suspension for chatter, tires for grip.
4) Conquer: return with better technique and setup, set new records, and unlock tougher hills.

Upgrade depth that matters
• Engine & torque for steep grades.
• Gear ratios to keep power in the usable band.
• Suspension & damping to stay planted over chatter and whoops.
• Tires & compound for traction on dirt, sand, mud, snow, rock.
• Weight & balance to reduce flips and keep drive wheels hooked up.
• Brakes & differential to stop precisely and put power down cleanly.

Game modes
• Career: climb hill by hill with increasing difficulty and unique biome rules.
• Trials: time attack, perfect run, no-flip, fuel-save, traction-limited challenges.
• Endless: go as far as you can on procedural terrain.
• Daily/Seasonal Events: rotating goals, limited-time tracks, exclusive rewards.

Designed for skill, not grind
No aggressive energy timers or mandatory paywalls. Progress with skillful driving, smart tuning, and course knowledge. Learn the hill, tune the car, own the climb.

Download Offroad Hill Racing and drive smarter today.

Bead 16 is a traditional two player abstract strategy game where players move their pieces across the board and capture opponent pieces by jumping over them. The player who captures all opponent pieces wins the match. The game is popular across India, Bangladesh, Pakistan and other South Asian regions, and is also known by names like Sholo Guti, 16 Goti, 16 Kaati, Indian Checkers and Sixteen Soldiers.

Play with computer AI to practice your strategy, then challenge friends and family in two player mode. Whether you call it Bead 16, Sholo Guti, 16 Guti, 16 Goti, Sixteen Soldiers or Indian Checkers, this is the classic board game experience made simple for mobile.

apps.title: Milk Register
apps.description:
A milk ledger for the Indian dairy trade.

A vendor delivers twice a day, a buyer takes from several vendors, rates change mid-month, and payments arrive in uneven lumps. Milk Register keeps that account straight and lets either side send the other a statement on WhatsApp.

WHAT IT KEEPS

• Parties and rates — vendors you buy from and clients you sell to. Change a rate from a date, and earlier entries keep the rate they were billed at.
• Entries by session — morning and evening, cow or buffalo, as a list or a month calendar with litres and value on every day.
• Payments that settle — money in either direction, applied to the oldest unpaid entries as far as it reaches.
• Reports and Excel — purchases and sales by volume and value, what you owe against what is owed to you, a per-party ledger and a month-by-month breakdown, exportable as a real .xlsx workbook.
• WhatsApp statements — an entry receipt, a payment receipt or a full account. Every message goes from your own WhatsApp.
• Reminders that learn — the app reads your last three weeks and works out which rounds you actually keep, then speaks up only when one is missing.

A RATE IS A DATE, NOT A SETTING

If the rate is a number stored on the vendor, raising it today silently reprices every entry you ever made, and a month you already settled stops adding up. Here a rate is a dated row: an entry is priced from the rate that applied on the entry's own date. Correct last week's litres and it stays at last week's price.

YOUR BOOK STAYS YOURS

Your account and your ledger, and nothing else. Not sold, not shared, not used for advertising. No advertising in the app and no tracking service in it. Your phone book is read only when you tap the button that fills a vendor's number, and only the contact you pick. How messages leave your phone is described below.

SENDING ON WHATSAPP, AND THE ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE

By default nothing is sent on your behalf: WhatsApp opens with the message already typed and the send is yours to press.

There is one optional setting, "Send automatically", which is off unless you turn it on. With it on, Milk Register uses Android's accessibility service to press send in WhatsApp for you and return to the app. While that setting is on, the service can read what is on the screen inside WhatsApp. It uses this only to find the send button for the message you just chose to share, and only in the few seconds after you tap share. It never runs in any other app, nothing it reads is stored or sent anywhere, and you can turn it off in Android's settings or in the app at any time. Before the setting can be switched on, the app explains all of this and asks you to agree.

Free. There is also a web panel at milkregister.com for the same ledger in a browser.

Herd & Cow Management

Log morning and evening milk yield for each cow and watch trends build into clear charts over time. Compare output across your herd, see totals by day, week, and month, and spot your top producers and underperformers without digging through old notebooks.

Keep vaccination, treatment, and deworming records for every animal, with reminders before checkups come due. Use it as a cow breeding tracker too: log breeding cycles, insemination dates, heat detection, and expected calving dates so nothing slips through the cracks.

Record what each cow eats and use the built-in feed cost calculator to see your real cost per liter of milk. Use that data to plan purchases and adjust feeding for better yield.
Farm Profit & Loss

See income from milk sales against your feed and veterinary spend in one dashboard. Export PDF reports to share with partners, cooperatives, or lenders, or just keep for your own records.
Built for offline use, with cloud sync, smart reminders, CSV and PDF export, and support for English and Hindi. Start managing your farm with real data instead of guesswork.

apps.title: Sholo Guti: Bead 16 Char Goti
apps.description:
Sholo Guti (Bead 16) is the classic two-player abstract strategy board game of Bengal, now on your phone. Line up your sixteen soldiers — your sixteen beads — and outsmart your opponent by capturing beads one by one. Hop your piece over an opposing bead into the empty point beyond, chain multiple captures in a single turn, and take your rival's beads sixteen times to win the board.

You may know this old folk pastime by many names: Sholo 16 Guti, Guti Bead 16, Bead 16 Guti, 16 Guti Bead, or simply the 16 boardgame. Some call it 16 Goti, Char Goti, Guti Sholo, or 16 Kaati. Whatever you call it, this is the same beloved 16 Goti board game — a Bangladeshi classic with roots in rural Bengal that families have loved for centuries. For anyone discovering Sholo Guti for the first time, gentle tutorials and three difficulty levels walk you through the rules before you challenge a friend.

Three timeless Guti classics come in one polished download, designed for board lovers, learners, and families wanting to relive their childhood folk pastimes:

Sholo Guti (Bead 16 / char goti board) — the original 16-bead capture classic played with 16 soldiers per side, the most famous and popular Guti game across Bangladesh and South Asia. Plan every 16 Goti move on the star grid.

Baro Guti (Bead 12 / 12 Guti) — a faster 12-bead variant on a smaller grid with the same deep strategy and quick jump tactics.

Baagh Chal (also spelled Bagh Chal / Bagchal) — the Nepali variant, a Nepali tiger-and-goat board game where the tigers hunt and capture goats while the goats try to trap the tigers. Pure asymmetric strategy in every move.

If you love games like chess, draughts, and Indian checkers, Bead 16 rewards clever, patient play the way those games do. It sits proudly beside other Asian classics and South Asian classics for anyone learning traditional folk pastimes and the traditional South Asian games their grandparents played.

Features you get:
- Three difficulty levels with smart move evaluation: easy mode for a quick local match, hard mode for a real fight
- Local pass-and-play on the same device, so two players share one phone
- Online multiplayer to challenge real players anywhere
- Five friendly themes: classic wood, premium green, royal purple, ocean blue and modern dark mode
- Simple tap or drag-and-drop controls and a configurable timer
- Bilingual interface in English and বাংলা
- Auto-save and resume, detailed stats, and win-rate tracking
- No forced sign-in and no purchases needed; crafted by Pixar Labs and updated regularly

Smooth gameplay, clean graphics, and a challenging opponent have made this a huge success at family gatherings and tea stalls. Bring your childhood back to life and enjoy traditional folk pastimes that have thrilled players from Bengal across South and East Asia for generations.

বাংলা: সোলো গুটি, বারো গুটি ও বাঘ চাল — একসাথে তিনটি ক্লাসিক বোর্ড গেম। বন্ধুর সাথে খেলুন বা কম্পিউটারের বিরুদ্ধে চ্যালেঞ্জ নিন এবং ছোটবেলার প্রিয় খেলা আবার উপভোগ করুন।

WHO THIS 16 GUTI BOARD GAME IS FOR
Anyone hunting classic board games, offline games for two, or 16 soldiers strategy games will find the full set here. Sixteen pieces placed on the star grid, sixteen squares of tactics, one classic board.

Bangladeshi classic, played the way you remember: no wifi required, no account, no timer pressure. Fully offline games you can resume seamlessly any time — the board waits where you left it, today or next week.

It runs at natural breakpoints, so a session that has to stop feels right: pause it, resume right where you left off, finish in 15 minutes or less. Move hints flag obvious mistakes while you learn. The rules are public domain, an Indian desi folk classic anyone can play.

Offline Sholo 16 for the commute, deep strategic gameplay for the evening. Simple rules, patient play: if you know chess, draughts or Indian checkers, this one reads instantly, then keeps surprising you twenty moves later.

apps.title: 16 Bead (Damru/16 Teni/Sholo G
apps.description:
In this game, two players can participate. Both players will have 16 bead, which they have to save from the opposite player. One player turns first and the second player needs to wait till his/her turn. When both players register, the game starts automatically. After that, the first player must move his/her bead to the nearest destination but, initially the player needs to choose his/her bead.

Players can move their bead in two ways, which are following.
1. By moving the nearest bead.
2. By crossing another player's bead.

In a first way, players can save their bead from another player.

Note: Players can move beads to the nearest place only once in their single turn.

In the Second way, players can cross another's player bead if the nearest bead is the opponent's bead and crossed location is empty, in other words, there is no bead in crossed point. After crossing bead, the player needs to pass turn by clicking on PASS button or by clicking on a bead which he/she moved after crossed

Note: Players can cross more than one bead in a single turn.

The result will depend on which player will lose first his/her all 16 beads. For Instance: if the player first will lose his/her bead then the winner is player second."

apps.title: BeadStudio: Fuse bead designer
apps.description:
Who doesn't love the fun and creative hobby of making fuse or melty bead designs and art. From kids to grownups, from toddlers to professional artists.

BeadStudio enables you to craft creative and beautiful designs and patterns before transferring them to real pegboards making them permanent by ironing the fuse beads. 

Explore new ideas and designs in the comfort of your sofa, backseat of the car or in the bus - not easily done with real melty beads.

Many different people are already using BeadStudio - from kids to artists - using it as a tool for their own designs, photorealistic artworks or pixel arts or just for recreation and meditation.

Use the built-in photo to bead conversion tool and transform your family photos, cat or landscape into designs using exactly the brand and colors of beads you have available.
BeadStudio supports all the major brands of fuse beads such as Hama Beads, Perler Beads, Artkal Beads, Nabbi Beads or Pyssla Beads in freehand artworks, figures like unicorns, bunnies, dinosaurs etc. and when making photorealistic designs.
BeadStudio supports mixing different types of beads in one single custom palette. You need that special green from brand A in your otherwise perfect brand B set of melty beads? No problem just make a custom palette!

Try out the new entertaining, meditative and calming feature: Bead By Numbers which is very similar to Paint By Numbers. Chose a variety of readily available figures, shapes and animals such as bunny, unicorn, butterfly, dinosaur, dog and many more. Each peg is numbered, select the matching fuse bead from the palette and start filling out the pattern.
Bead by numbers helps kids improve their motor skills and stimulates them to try out other similar designs using the basic design as inspiration, just with different colors. Zooming in makes the beads big enough for even the smallest fingers - BeadStudio is easy to use for kids and adults alike.

Fuse beads can be used for many different designs and projects - inspiration is all around the internet with fun and beautiful ideas like Christmas ornaments, alphabets, jewelry, necklaces, keychains, fridge magnets and even bowls baked in the oven. All perfect gifts for parents and grand-parents.

Fuse beads has been around for a long time and will continue to be a creative and entertaining pastime for all ages where in the later years melty beads has become a cool, hip and trendy thing where dedicated groups of grown-ups around the world are cultivating this hobby celebrating a nostalgic trip back to their childhood.
Using BeadStudio is as simple as finger painting. Create a new standard rectangular board or chose from many of the readymade templates, shapes and figures. If you want to change the design into real beads afterwards you should chose the brand of beads you have available such as Hama Beads, Perler Beads, Artkal Beads, Nabbi Beads or Pyssla Beads. If you don’t have all the colors then just make your own palette with the colors you have, where mixing beads from different brands is possible. Use the different tools available for placing single beads at a time or drawing/painting with the brush tool. Making mistakes is part of it; this is where undo/redo and the eraser tool comes in handy. 

Generating boards from photos can make some marvelous designs, and you can control many aspects of the image before conversion such as dithering, coloring and lighting. Use the crop tool to select which area of the photo you want to convert, just set the size of the board you want to make first (such as 58x58 beads) and then the aspect ratio of the cropping area is fixed. You can now select the area and zoom in and out to your liking; it’s really simple and easy to use!

Any questions or suggestions don’t hesitate to contact me at datscharf@gmail.com

BeadStudio needs internet and external storage permissions to convert images from web storage and loading and saving designs to internal flash.

•	Dune Buggy: Lightweight and agile, built for sand and air. High flip potential, low stability on rocky terrain.
•	4x4 Truck: The ultimate all-rounder. Solid grip on dirt, mud, and loose surfaces — reliable across every world.
•	On-Road Racer: Maximum speed on asphalt, fragile everywhere else. High risk, high reward on Asphalt City.

________________________________________
🔧 UPGRADE YOUR RIDE
Push each vehicle to its limit by upgrading core components:
•	Engine: More horsepower for climbing the steepest slopes with ease.
•	Suspension: Absorb rough, bumpy terrain for smoother and safer landings.
•	Tires: Maximize grip and traction on sand, dirt, mud, and wet roads.
•	Chassis & Fuel Tank: Optimize vehicle balance and extend your driving distance.
________________________________________
🌍 5 CHALLENGING TRACK WORLDS
•	Asphalt City: Smooth tarmac, fast straights, and urban obstacles. Where top speed and precise throttle control decide the race.
•	Farm Offroad: Loose dirt, muddy trails, and uneven ground across open countryside. Suspension and traction over raw speed.
•	Maze Stunt: A labyrinth of ramps, jumps, and aerial traps. Master your flips or lose time recovering.
•	Rocky Mountain: Steep inclines, jagged surfaces, and unpredictable drops. The ultimate engine and chassis test.
•	Dune: Shifting sand, blind crests, and long airtime. Light vehicles and upgraded tires dominate here.
New worlds added with every update — there's always a new challenge to conquer.
________________________________________
🌟 KEY GAME FEATURES
•	100% Offline: Full game access, zero Wi-Fi required. Works on planes, commutes, and remote areas.
•	Realistic 3D Physics: Authentic suspension, weight transfer, and responsive vehicle handling on every surface.
•	Stunt System: Pull off front flips and backflips mid-air to earn bonus rewards and extra coins.
•	Diverse Terrain: Loose sand, wet roads, dirt trails, steep slopes — every surface demands a different approach.
•	Regular Updates: New vehicles and worlds added continuously — always something new to unlock.
•	Free to Play: Unlock content through gameplay; coins and gems accelerate your progress.
________________________________________
Can you master every hill and outlast every rival? Download Rush to Race: Hill Racing — free, offline, always.
